  typstdoc-typst:
    terms-tight: false
    terms-spacing: 1.5em
    terms-indent: 1em
    terms-hanging-indent: 3em
    terms-separator: "—"
    term-color: maroon
    term-weight: regular
---

This example spreads items apart, indents the whole list, and uses a deeper definition indent, an em dash separator, and plain maroon terms:

```yaml
terms-tight: false
terms-spacing: 1.5em
terms-indent: 1em
terms-hanging-indent: 3em
terms-separator: "—"
term-color: maroon
term-weight: regular
```

# Term lists

Pandoc wraps each definition in a block, so the definition starts on the line below its term and is indented by `terms-hanging-indent`. A definition with more than one paragraph needs a blank line between the term and the `:` line, or Pandoc joins the paragraphs.

Typst
: A markup-based typesetting system.

Quarto
: An open-source scientific and technical publishing system built on Pandoc. This definition is long enough to wrap so you can see how the hanging indent lines up continuation lines.

Pandoc

: A universal document converter.

    A definition can hold more than one paragraph.

`code` and *emphasis* in a term
: Inline formatting in the term is kept alongside the term styling.

Some body text after the list shows the spacing below it.
